# Hi/Lo Ventures Group

> Hi/Lo Ventures Group is a micro-SaaS venture studio that builds, launches, and invests in simple, AI-powered software for small contractors and the trades.

Hi/Lo Ventures Group creates practical, subscription-based software that helps small contractors and tradespeople run their businesses — from first estimate to final invoice. As a venture studio, we build, launch, and invest in these tools ourselves. Our focus is construction and home-maintenance trades, and our products are designed to be simple to adopt and use on the jobsite.

## Products
- ezQuote Pro: a voice-powered proposal and invoicing tool built for contractors. Create proposals, invoices, and change orders instantly from the jobsite.
